status: frozen observed browser baseline; noisy shared-machine population, not native or stable-platform qualification
selectionPolicy: One final sequential Chromium/WebKit pair (15393/15394) after adding diagnostic metadata; no retry-until-green, trimming, warmup omission or outlier exclusion. Every earlier completed measurement cohort remains indexed below with its original raw artifact, including failed gates. Relative budgets are future comparisons, not a claim that these different-load cohorts agree within 5%.
policy: Compare only the same machine, engine, build and measurement method. Each median and nearest-rank p95 ceiling is baseline + max(5%, 20 ms). Absolute smoke ceilings remain startup 5000 ms and task switch 1000 ms.

measurement.startup: Runner monotonic reload to selected synthetic thread and enabled composer; not cold native startup or Vite build time.
measurement.taskSwitch: In-page UI click to first animation frame with selected synthetic thread and enabled composer; runner round-trip overhead is reported separately.
measurement.memory: Uncollected Chromium JS heap proxy, not RSS or proof of no leak. WebKit heap and native RSS are unavailable, not zero.

chromium.residentMemoryUnavailableReason: Native webview and host RSS not measured in browser preview

webkit.heapUnavailableReason: CDP heap metric unavailable in WebKit
webkit.residentMemoryUnavailableReason: Native webview and host RSS not measured in browser preview

machine.conditions: Shared machine; no unrelated workload stopped. Per-cohort free-memory snapshots are in raw artifacts. Not a controlled idle-machine benchmark.

earlierCohorts.artifactPolicy: All paths below are relative to playwright-report/ and end with extensions-baseline-extens-7172f-tch-and-memory-measurements/measurements.json. Original raw JSON, metadata and failed traces are retained, not overwritten by the final pair.

nativeQualification: unavailable; browser samples do not qualify native IPC, RSS, menus, updater restart or cross-platform support
